monster:ape.visualDescription: A rusty-red ape stands with both long arms raised, broad chest, small head, and dark feet.
monster:ape.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ape as a strong omnivorous primate with two claws and a bite.
monster:ape.modelBrief: Make a muscular tailless ape with wide raised arms and warm red-brown fur, larger and heavier than the monkey. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:owlbear.visualDescription: A large brown beast has owl-like facial tufts, a pale belly, thick arms, and grasping claws.
monster:owlbear.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the owlbear as a large carnivorous creature that seizes prey with its claws.
monster:owlbear.modelBrief: Combine bear mass and forelimbs with a distinct owl face and ear tufts, preserving the cream belly patch. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:yeti.visualDescription: A pale gray-white shaggy humanoid has broad arms, black face, red eyes, and large feet.
monster:yeti.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the yeti as a strong carnivorous apelike creature with claws and a bite.
monster:yeti.modelBrief: Sculpt a bulky white-furred ape with dark face mask, red eye accents, and short heavy legs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:carnivorous ape.visualDescription: A tall dark ape raises powerful blue-gray arms around a black face with bright red eyes.
monster:carnivorous ape.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the carnivorous ape as a fiercer obligate-carnivore relative of the ape.
monster:carnivorous ape.modelBrief: Use the ape skeleton with slate-dark fur, oversized shoulders, and intense red eyes; keep hands open and claw-ready. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:sasquatch.visualDescription: A reddish-brown shaggy sasquatch has long arms, wide legs, red eyes, and a dark open mouth.
monster:sasquatch.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies sasquatch as the most difficult of its apelike class, able to see invisible.
monster:sasquatch.modelBrief: Build a large upright hairy ape with a broad shoulder line, warm brown fur, and red eyes. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:kobold zombie.visualDescription: A small greenish kobold zombie has a long snout, hunched back, torn body, and reaching hands.
monster:kobold zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki calls the kobold zombie the weakest zombie, an undead version of the small kobold.
monster:kobold zombie.modelBrief: Make a short decayed kobold with protruding muzzle and stiff clawing arms, using olive skin and dark rotten patches. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome zombie.visualDescription: A short gnome zombie wears a floppy gray cap and dark blue clothes, with yellow eyes and raised hands.
monster:gnome zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a zombified gnome that claws and can follow the hero between levels.
monster:gnome zombie.modelBrief: Keep short gnome proportions and recognizable cap, with dull skin, vacant eyes, and torn blue garments. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:orc zombie.visualDescription: A thin orc zombie has a pale green square face, yellow eye, red-brown clothes, and long reaching arms.
monster:orc zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an undead orc that appears in groups and attacks with a claw.
monster:orc zombie.modelBrief: Make a lanky rotting orc with angular snout and sparse reddish clothing, retaining the long-armed silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:dwarf zombie.visualDescription: A broad dwarf zombie has a beardlike pale face, pointed head shapes, maroon clothes, and stout feet.
monster:dwarf zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a zombified dwarf with a claw attack.
monster:dwarf zombie.modelBrief: Preserve a stocky dwarf body and pronounced face or beard under torn red-brown clothing and undead coloring. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:elf zombie.visualDescription: A slim elf zombie wears a brown cap, ochre shirt, and dark leggings; its long arms reach sideways.
monster:elf zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an undead elf with a claw attack and the ability to follow the hero across levels.
monster:elf zombie.modelBrief: Use elongated elven limbs and a simple tan tunic, adding sallow skin and ragged edges. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:human zombie.visualDescription: A narrow human zombie has a pale head, yellow eyes, long hanging arms, and torn tan clothing.
monster:human zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a human corpse reanimated as a clawing undead humanoid.
monster:human zombie.modelBrief: Build a gaunt stiff human with exposed pale face and torn beige shirt, keeping the upright stagger. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ettin zombie.visualDescription: An enormous ettin zombie has two pale heads, thick green-brown arms, wide belly, and dark loincloth.
monster:ettin zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a zombified two-headed ettin and one of the strongest ordinary zombies.
monster:ettin zombie.modelBrief: Make a giant rotting two-headed body with thick asymmetric arms, dull olive hide, and heavy stance. The paired atlas slots can share this design.
